repositoryBinding_historyLabels.title: Remove remote history
repositoryBinding_historyLabels.boundary: Deleting local records or remote files does not erase Git history. Disconnecting sync does not delete the repository.
steps: Export any local backup you want to keep, then disconnect the repository sync binding.
Check the dedicated repository’s owner and name on GitHub, then follow the official guide to delete the whole repository yourself. This removes its contents and associated permissions.

To resume sync, create a new private dedicated repository with a README, then authorise, verify and bind it again. New uploads include effective records still retained locally; delete unwanted old records locally before uploading again.
repositoryBinding_historyLabels.limits: Lingfern requests no repository-deletion permission and cannot guarantee removal of GitHub backups, downloaded copies or old local backups.
